title: Squared Fourier coefficient of the complete quadratic
statement: Let $n$ be an even natural number, and let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The square of the vector Fourier coefficient of the sign encoding of the complete quadratic bit at $\gamma$ is $2^{-n}$.
